title: Kicked Spicy Brazilian Mackerel En Croute
description: A spicy Brazilian dish featuring mackerel in a flaky crust, with a kick of heat and a side of fermented jelly for an anti-inflammatory boost.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a large rectangle.
Place the mackerel fillets in the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around them.
Brush the edges of the pastry with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Spoon the spicy Brazilian sauce over the mackerel, leaving a small border around the edges.
Top the sauce with the fermented jelly, spreading it evenly.
Fold the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with olive oil and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Place the en croute on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
